events.title: Eni Shareholders Back €4 Billion Buyback and Confirm New Board
events.body: Italian energy major approves 2025 accounts, dividend plan, and governance changes.

events.title: VNOM Q1 Earnings Beat Estimates on Higher Production Volume
events.body: Viper Energy beats Q1 earnings estimates on higher production volume and surging royalty income, driving operating income growth and strong shareholder returns.

events.title: PBF Energy Q1 Earnings Miss Estimates, Revenues Increase Y/Y
events.body: PBF narrows its Q1 loss despite higher costs, as strong refining margins and throughput growth drive a revenue beat and an operational turnaround.

events.title: Antero Midstream Q1 Earnings Miss Estimates, Revenues Increase Y/Y
events.body: AM's Q1 revenues top estimates on strong volumes, but rising costs weigh on earnings despite robust gathering and compression growth.
